Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) The Service of “Hiring of Sanitation Service – Sweeper” for cleaning and sanitization of ‘all areas’ of the Aayakar Bhawan, Milan Nagar, Dibrugarh shall be provided for a period of 2 (Two) years. The Contractor shall deploy 10 (Ten) nos. of Sweepers for 6 (Six) days every week as decided by the Building-in-charge. Cleaning shall be done twice daily (morning and afternoon) and also as and when required during the day. The reporting time and duty hours of the Sweepers shall be as fixed by the Building-in-charge. The morning cleaning job shall be completed before 9:30 A.M. every duty day. On duty days that are not working days of the Office, the jobs shall be done as directed by the Building-in-charge, and the work-done register shall be signed on the next working day of the Office. In case of absence of any Sweeper, the Contractor shall provide a substitute Sweeper on the same day, so that the strength of 10 (Ten) Sweepers is maintained on all duty days. Supervisory personnel of the Contractor, with local office, shall be available on all occasions. The Contractor shall designate one of the deployed Sweepers as team leader, who shall report to the Building-in-charge daily. The “Minimum Wage Per Month Per Resource (including ESI, PF, EDLI, PF Admin Charge, and relieving charges if applicable) in INR exclusive of GST” shall be calculated as below:

For the purposes of the Contract as per this Bid, the Service Provider is required to: Have an officially registered address (i.e., office address registered on GST Registration/ MSE Registration) in the district of Dibrugarh, Assam. Possess valid EPF and ESIC registrations. Not have been indicted for any criminal, fraudulent or anti-competition activity, and not have been debarred/ blacklisted by any Department of the Central Govt./ State Govt./ PSU/ Public bodies/ Municipalities. Additional eligibility criteria: The prospective Bidders are also required to visit the site where the services are required (the premises of Aayakar Bhawan, Milan Nagar, Dibrugarh), at their own cost during working hours of the Income-tax Office, Milan Nagar, Dibrugarh during the duration of the Bid for eligibility to participate in this Bid. “Similar services” for the purposes of Experience Criteria shall mean experience of housekeeping/ cleaning/ sanitation services in Office Buildings/ Campuses in the state of Assam. The following documents shall be required for successful Technical evaluation: 1. Certificate of Acceptance of Additional Terms and Conditions of the Bid, Scope of Work, Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA, Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW), Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC etc. 2. Proof of Availability of registered Office in the district of Dibrugarh, Assam, copies of EPF and ESIC registration certificates, and the Declaration regarding debarment {Annexure-A, as per the proforma given as file attachment in the ‘Buyer added bid specific Scope of Work(SOW)’ of the Bid}. 3. PAN and GST details 4. Documents in support of meeting the Experience Criteria {including Annexure-B, as per the proforma given as file attachment in the ‘Buyer added bid specific Scope of Work(SOW)’ of the Bid} and Turnover (or documents in support of claim of exemption from the Experience and Turnover criteria) as specified in the Bid Document The Bidder shall upload their acceptance of Additional Terms and Conditions of the Bid, Scope of Work, Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA, Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW), Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC etc., in the Technical Bid in the “Certificate (Requested in ATC)” section. The Bidder shall upload proof of Availability of registered Office in the district of Dibrugarh, Assam, copies of EPF and ESIC registration certificates, the Declaration regarding debarment in the prescribed proforma and any other related documents in the “Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)” section of their technical bid. The Bidder shall upload their PAN, GST details and any other relevant documents in the “Additional Doc 2 (Requested in ATC)” section of their technical bid. The Bidder shall upload the documents in support of meeting the Experience Criteria (including the List of Major Clients as per Annexure-B, with copies of work orders) and Bidder Turnover criteria in the respective “Experience Criteria” and “Bidder Turnover” related sections of their technical bid. 10.
